FD004_ONE_WAY_TEST_ADMISSION_CONTRACT_63.authorized_data_access: FD004 held-out TEST inputs and official RUL labels may be opened only for fixed final evaluation
FD004_ONE_WAY_TEST_ADMISSION_CONTRACT_63.test_evaluation_rule: Open held-out FD004 TEST and official RUL once; apply frozen TRAIN/FIT-derived preprocessing, frozen model, frozen MC-dropout protocol, frozen risk construction/calibration, and frozen threshold/policy exactly; report full, accepted, and abstained endpoint MAE and coverage; do not tune anything using TEST outcomes.
FD004_ONE_WAY_TEST_ADMISSION_CONTRACT_63.test_result_interpretation_rule: Report the held-out result as observed, whether selective performance improves, is neutral, or worsens.
